text.text_excerpt: First off a breakfast/brunch spot that takes reservations! AND it opens at 7am for the early birds and stays open until 3 for the folks who can't make it out of bed or their house before noon. We had a variety of dishes. I had the avocado toast and added an egg. OMG so tasty with toasted sunflower seeds and some orange oil, it was so bright and perfect. And my friends and I shared the bubble waffle which was perfect and delightful and may have put me in a carb coma... or maybe that was the side of biscuit and jam that I had to have. My biscuit was delicious and the strawberry jam was yummy. I was really happy to see a bunch of vegetarian/vegan (?) options on the menu. I think this has bee...

First time eating here and it didn't disappoint. It was very busy for Sunday brunch. All the tables were reserved already except for outside dining, which we were fine. The weather was beautiful and it was covered. We enjoy being outdoor when weather is nice. Service was great. Waitress was very informative and honest. I was between two entrees and she helped me to make the right decision lol. Food came out very timely, especially for being busy for brunch. Food was delicious. French toast was great. Basic breakfast with pancakes bacon and eggs are delicious. Love their fried chicken on biscuit with country gravy. Their mushroom Benedict was amazing. Yum. Everything we got was delicious a...

Had a great brunch here today after my spin class. Such a cute, quaint place with a laid back vibe. I had arrived 20 minutes earlier than my reservation time and was greeted warmly and seated immediately. Soft pastels, light wood and florals decorate the space. Lots of homage to plant life around on the walls and the table top decor that hosts small potted plants. My spot had a view of the outside that houses additional tables under canopy tents they have lantern and twinkling fairy lights. I enjoyed my brunch cocktail of a cold brew old fashioned and my entree was the pulled pork Benedict which was well portioned and executed wonderfully with greens on the side.
